designationHistory.indexText: Established in 1984 when the U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service bought 340 acres on St. Croix from the West Indies Investment Company to protect nesting leatherback sea turtles.
designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year. The refuge page does not say how it was established.
